generator: Heterogeneous positive current holdings, lognormal relative target tilts, two forced exits, correlated market/sector/factor covariance with positive residuals, three sector rows and optionally three overlapping fractional rows. Bands centred on the feasible base. No private inputs.
decision_rule: Keep current full-search defaults unless OneAnchor has no disadvantage above the existing descriptive band, no extra audit/solver failures, and lower paired median time on the new broad cases. Passing this sample is only a candidate for separate production qualification, not permission to switch production.
failure_policy: Record every case and arm, including failures. Freeze source and design before the first primary solve. Do not retune on these new outcomes.
timing: Serial calls; reverse heuristic and independent Exact orders on odd case indices; reverse started Exact order too. Preparation and start generation charged separately. Native work may overrun requested limits. No equal-wall-time claim.
certificates: Use existing plain/perspective supporting-plane LP dual bounds with box residual correction and floating-point guard. Native MIP bounds remain diagnostic. Exhaustive tiny-case full-weight QPs are numerical reference solutions, not exact-arithmetic certificates.
